text: Good evening please. I am a childminder and I am having a 2 year old girl with me tonight because her mummy is on night shift. Since around 9pm she has been hot to touch so I checked her temperature and it is 38.4. I have been watching her since then. The other thing is that her eczema has flared up seriously, the dry patches on her cheeks and her arms are very rough and she is scratching them well well, I have put her cream but she is still rubbing them. Abeg I am not a nurse and this child is not my own, so I am very afraid of doing the wrong thing. I don't want her mummy to come back and see that something happened under my care. Please what should I be doing for the temperature, and is there anything for the itching that I can do tonight until morning when her mummy will take over? I will be very grateful for any advice
